answer.explanation: The live CompressionFunction config (Timeout=3s, MemorySize=128MB, last modified 22:52:17Z, just before the window) differs from the committed IaC (Timeout=60, MemorySize=1024). In the window, every invocation in the log group reports Duration 3000.00 ms and Status: timeout, while Max Memory Used stays around 93-95 MB. The timeouts point to the 3s timeout, with the 128MB memory allocation also reduced from the intended 1024MB. The OUTPUT_BUCKET commits (a9f46ca, reverted in 96509c8) are not the cause: the live OUTPUT_BUCKET is the correct output bucket, and the reverted value 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca' is not deployed. Other functions' live configs match the IaC.
